name: Mansi Finance (Chennai) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Mansi Finance (Chennai) Ltd is in the business of financing commercial loans[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is registered as a Non-Deposit taking and non systematically important Non-Banking Finance Company. It is engaged in lending, financing and investment activities

pros: Stock is trading at 0.65 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 6.88% over last 3 years.
